description: Fetch a captured download using its artifact_id from list_downloads, in chunks of at most 1 MiB. Returns session_id, artifact_id, content_type, data_base64, offset, total_bytes and next_offset. Decode each chunk separately and concatenate the bytes. Repeat with offset set to next_offset until next_offset is null. Defaults to offset 0 and this connection's active session.

offset.description: Byte offset to fetch, starting at 0. Use next_offset from the previous chunk to continue.

name: get_download
title: Fetch download
